messages:
Alex (support): @Maria we have an enterprise customer (Acme Corp) hitting toolcall failures when calling the billing tool via API. Error: schema validation failed — additionalProperties ['metadata'] not allowed + required property 'line_items' missing. Customer payload below.

Customer payload:
```json
{
  "customer_id": "acme-123",
  "billing_profile": {"id":"bp_987"},
  "amount": 1200,
  "metadata": {"internal_note":"override"}
}
```

API response:
```json
{
  "error": "FunctionSchemaValidationError",
  "details": [
    {"path": "/line_items", "error": "required"},
    {"path": "/", "error": "additionalProperties: metadata"}
  ]
}
```

They're blocked in production. Requesting triage and repro steps. CC @Chris (sre) @Maria (eng)

Dana (support): Logged as P1, customer is on Dedicated. Request id: rq_0a1b2c3d. Sharing headers/tenant id in DM.

Maria (eng): Can you paste the full request_id and raw request bytes? Which SDK/version? We've seen older SDKs send top-level metadata. @Chris any infra noise?

Chris (sre): No cluster-wide incidents in last 24h. I do see a spike in 95th pct latency for billing-tool around that window. I'll pull logs for rq_0a1b2c3d.

Alex (support): SDK v0.9.2 (node). Customer added 'metadata' recently and omitted line_items relying on server-side defaulting. They say it worked until yesterday.

Maria (eng): Sounds like schema-hardening landed yesterday that enforces additionalProperties=false and requires line_items. Reproduced locally by calling billing tool with payload above -> same error. Repro steps:
1) curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/invoke -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '@payload.json'
2) payload.json contains the body above

Result: 400 FunctionSchemaValidationError (required line_items, additionalProperties metadata).

Chris (sre): Log snippet for rq_0a1b2c3d: 'schema_validator: error additionalProperties metadata' and 'latency: 420ms'. Attached trace.

Maria (eng): Proposed fixes:
- Rollback strict schema change for billing tool (fast but risky)
- Add compatibility shim: accept additionalProperties, strip unknown keys server-side, and default line_items=[] if missing
- Patch SDKs to stop sending metadata and ensure line_items present

Dana (support): Customer prefers a server-side quick fix. They can't update SDK immediately.

Alex (support): Customer agreed to temporary fallback.

Maria (eng): I'll open a patch to enable additionalProperties in the validator for billing and add a normalizer that strips unknowns and injects default line_items. Will canary to 5% tonight. PR: redwood/billing#1234. ETA ~3h for patch + 1h canary. Assigning to me.

Chris (sre): I'll watch the canary and alert on error rate/regressions. Ping me for rollback.

deploy-bot: deploy started for billing-tool-normalizer canary -> canary id c-789, route 5%, commit sha abcdef

Dana (support): Notified customer of expected window. Will keep them updated.

Alex (support): Marking as escalated -> owner: Maria (eng). Will follow up in 3h or on rollback. :thumbsup: 

Maria (eng): UPDATE: Canary shows no schema errors in 5% traffic, error rate dropped to baseline. Rolling to 100% in 30m. Will post final status.

Chris (sre): No regressions detected during canary.

Alex (support): Customer confirmed their calls now succeed in prod. Closing after final confirm.

Maria (eng): FINAL: customer verified production success. Root cause: schema-hardening change removed backward-compatible additionalProperties and defaulting. Actions: add integration test and SDK compatibility note. Created ticket INF-678 for retrospective.
